about: Hand annotations of the Camry side tests' films, merged into docs/crash-reference/nhtsa/media/<test>.json by `side_compare.py notes`. Frames are the film's burned-in frame numbers (Frame: 1 is the file's first); ms = (frame - t0_frame) * 1000 / fps_film. Everything here was seen on the films or read in the report; 'inferred' marks the rest. engine/docs/crash-reference/camry-side-comparison.md has the timelines.

hs.time_source: burned-in caption on every frame: '<ms> ms, 1,000 fps, Frame: <n>'; 0.00 ms at Frame 51 (checked on every film used); the report's camera table gives 1,000 fps

rt.time_source: real-time camera (30 fps, report camera table); no time caption; first contact not established

7517.summary: 2012 Camry LE (1,641 kg as tested), NCAP side: the FMVSS 214 MDB (1,361.5 kg) crabbed 26.9 deg at 62.3 km/h into the stationary car's left side; the MDB's forward edge 463 mm aft of the front axle (intended 447; 16 mm rearward). The car's CG gains 6.6 m/s across by 88 ms (half of it by 21 ms), with a 31.8 g spike at 6 ms; the MDB loses 8.6 m/s. Front door glass breaks (25-40 ms); doors jammed shut, no pillar or sill separation; maximum static crush 275 mm (mid-door, 450 mm behind the impact line); B-post width 197 mm narrower. The car yaws nose-left about 14 deg by 150 ms and 30 deg by 300 ms (engine and trunk-floor accelerometers).
sources: report v07517R001.pdf p.6 summary and speeds
p.22-23 post-test observations and impact point
p.24 MDB weights, speed and angles, honeycomb crush
p.26-27 exterior crush levels and grid
EV5 curves v07517.033-.060 (CG, sills, A-post, engine, trunk floor, MDB CG)

8560.summary: 2014.5 Camry LE (1,649 kg), NCAP side: MDB (1,361.6 kg) crabbed 26.8 deg at 61.9 km/h; impact point 455 mm aft of the front axle (intended 444). CG gains 6.8 m/s across by 110 ms (half by 22 ms), 35.6 g spike at 7 ms; MDB loses 8.1 m/s by 150 ms. Curtain airbag full by 15 ms, front door glass crazes at 25 ms and bursts at 30-40 ms; belt line visibly bowed by 20 ms. Doors jammed shut; maximum static crush 258 mm (mid-door); B-post width 352 mm narrower (pre-test 1,974 mm: not the same measurement as 7517's 1,821, inferred). Yaw nose-left about 15 deg by 150 ms, 33 deg by 300 ms.
sources: p.26-27 exterior crush levels and grid

7523.summary: 2012 Camry LE (1,566 kg), NCAP oblique pole: carried at 75 deg into a rigid 254 mm pole at 32.1 km/h, the pole on the driver's head CG, 1,101 mm aft of the front axle (front door). The pulse lasts about 150 ms (CG half of its 10.3 m/s change by 62 ms; 16.5 g peak at 34 ms); pole force 191 kN at 44 ms. The side wraps around the pole: maximum crush 394 mm (mid-door, at the pole), wheelbase 129 mm and left side 135 mm shorter, B-pillar width 111 mm less; windshield cracked, front door glass broken. Small yaw (nose-left about 4 deg by 150 ms); the car stays at the pole.
sources: p.17 camera table (1,000 fps; note: vehicle at 15 deg to the pole, i.e. 75 deg travel)
p.20-21 observations, impact point and speed
p.23-24 exterior crush levels and grid
EV5 curves v07523.017-.042 (CG, A/B-post, engine, firewall, roof, sill, trunk, 8 pole load cells)

8558.summary: 2014.5 Camry LE (1,579 kg), NCAP oblique pole at 31.95 km/h, 75 deg, pole 1,125 mm aft of the front axle. CG half of its 10.9 m/s change by 60 ms, pulse about 150 ms, 17.9 g peak at 15 ms; pole force 197 kN at 46 ms. Maximum crush 379 mm at mid-door 75 mm behind the impact line (sill 340, window sill 340); wheelbase 106 mm shorter, B-pillar width 257 mm less; windshield cracked, door glass broken (window crazes by 20 ms, bursts by 40 ms on the overhead close-up). Small yaw, nose-left about 5 deg by 150 ms.
sources: p.20-21 observations, impact point and speed
p.23-24 exterior crush levels and grid
